description: A quality director must decide how to disposition Batch B-417 after a packaging-label printer outage and finalize the relabeling, verification, and customer-approval controls before the batch record is closed, with input from a packaging engineer and a customer quality liaison.

shared_context.S1: Batch B-417 contains 1,200 molded housings and is currently on quality hold after a packaging-label printer outage.
shared_context.S2: Dimensional inspection results for the batch are within the internal specification.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final batch disposition and close the batch record.
shared_context.S4: The routine disposition review includes a check with packaging engineering and the customer quality liaison before the hold is cleared.

PF1.text: Jon's packaging shift log shows that exactly 240 housings were packed while the printer was malfunctioning; their labels lack the required machine-readable lot code. Procedure requires those 240 units to be relabeled after a 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup job, followed by barcode verification. Jon completed the log this shift, but it has not yet been uploaded to the batch record.

PF2.text: Elena received a signed customer amendment this morning stating that the 240 relabeled housings may be released only after exactly 20 of them pass customer reapproval inspection; the amendment permits the other 960 correctly labeled housings to be released separately. She has not attached the emailed amendment to the batch record yet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 960 correctly labeled housings must be released separately.
Exactly 240 housings must remain held for relabeling.
Relabeling must include a 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup job.
Barcode verification must occur after relabeling.
Exactly 20 relabeled housings must undergo customer reapproval inspection.
The signed customer amendment must be attached to the batch record.

decisive_facts.why: The packaging log changes the disposition to exactly 960 released and 240 held, and changes the work plan to a 2-hour setup followed by mandatory barcode verification.
The signed customer amendment changes the relabeled-unit release condition to exactly 20 customer-reapproved samples and requires an amendment-attachment commitment plus citation of PF2.
